title: actions: an `api` action called with no recordId forwards an unresolved `{id}` path and answers 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND instead of naming the missing record id
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZpHPpovxXPremPLtv

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 公开入口 HTTP `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` 实测一次错误结果）
业务理由: 通过 REST 或 MCP 调用记录型 `api` 动作的集成方，漏传 recordId 时得到「端点不存在」，会以为路由坏了或版本不对，而不是自己少传了参数。不修，排障成本一直落在调用方身上。
动手的读者: domain:server 席，`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `buildApiActionRequest`（`{field}` 令牌未替换时提前 400 拒收），附 action door HTTP pin。
查重: `repo is:issue ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND recordId` 21 命中、`buildApiActionRequest` 3（#27738、#27611、#27610，都不是本现象）、`api action unresolved token` 105（均含已关）。

QA-source: #28927 · approvals.account-app-entry · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
`POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` with `{"params":{}}` (no `recordId`), or with `"recordId":""`, answers **404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` "Not found"**. The caller is told the endpoint does not exist, when the real problem is the missing record id the action's target path needs. The same call with a real request id answers 200 (the #28657 fix holds), and with an unknown id answers 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot, as a non-admin pending approver (the #28657 persona).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the stock showcase and mint the #28657 persona X (invite-member + sign-up; positions contributor and finance; X creates a showcase_invoice and PATCHes it to `status: sent` with `issued_on`).
2. As X: `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` `{"params":{}}`.
3. **Expected:** 400 naming the missing `recordId` (the action declares a record-anchored target).
4. **Actual:** 404 `{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}`. Same with `"recordId":""`.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f, a guess)
`buildApiActionRequest` in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` substitutes `{field}` tokens only when a subject row is present, and its unresolved-token guard checks only `${…}` and `{{` forms, so the forward goes out with `{id}` literally in the path and the router answers 404.
